description: Internal child of TmPdfViewer that renders the continuous mode's Blazor-owned annotation overlay slots for the pages the JS geometry report mounts. The [JSInvokable] geometry report forwards to SetGeometry, which re-renders this component only — the root viewer never re-renders for a geometry report. MarkStale hides the slots until the next report arrives (an in-place zoom must not paint stale boxes).

parameters.name: EnableAnnotations
parameters.description: Whether the per-page annotation layers render (else host overlays only).

parameters.name: CurrentUserId
parameters.description: Current user id used for mention styling.

parameters.name: ShowResolved
parameters.description: Whether resolved threads should be rendered.

parameters.name: PageOverlayContent
parameters.description: The templated per-page overlay rendered in every mounted slot.

parameters.name: DraftAnchorProvider
parameters.description: Resolves the draft anchor for one page (the pending selection only paints in the slot of the page it was made on).

parameters.name: OnThreadSelected
parameters.description: Callback invoked when a thread marker or highlight is selected.
